rv.q: She is effortlessly engaging — energetic, carefree, and endlessly likeable. Her buoyant presence keeps the piece hopeful, and it’s easy to see why Jack falls for her through words alone. I couldn’t help but wonder if this was truly what Ludwig’s mother was like — and if so, what a wonderful woman she must have been.

Currently making its UK debut at Arcola Theatre, Dear Jack, Dear Louise is inspired by those letters, bringing to life the real love story that came to be over thousands of letters written over the course of several years. Louise, played brilliantly by Eva Feiler, is an exuberant, theatrically-inclined, aspiring Broadway actress.

There is an ongoing feeling that this idea’s potential could have been further and better exploited.
